1001129033.text:
Each year, Intuit experiences a surge in traffic around tax filing season, providing a critical window to conduct iterative customer experiments. The faster teams can design, implement, and deploy new content, messaging, and features, the faster the company can improve the experience for its users and achieve its business goals.

Our partners in Intuit's Marketing Technology team launch dozens of experiments each quarter on the marketing website to drive more conversions. This includes the product selection pages for Intuit's flagship TurboTax product, seen by millions every day.

The team uses a homegrown CMS platform to deliver these experiments.

1001129053.text: Prior to Plasmic, Intuit faced the following challenges:

1001129179.text: To accelerate experimentation, the team is focusing on the following key areas:

1001129184.text: "We only have a window of 6-8 weeks leading up to a tax season peak to launch experiments, where we launch, get confidence in results, and roll it into the baseline. With everything from small tweaks to big swings, Plasmic helps us more than double what we can do within this short window. We were able to find significant conversion rate lift with Plasmic."

1001129499.text: Enable non-developers, such as designers and marketers, to implement new content and variations quickly.

1001129515.text: Double the number of experiments conducted per season

1001129517.text: Reduce the cost of implementation to drastically increase the number of experiments running in A/B tests.

1001129535.text: Work within the existing tech stack and allow teammates to start with limited surfaces, without requiring a full re-implementation or port of existing work.

1001129796.text: James Armenta, the lead engineer defining a new process of rapid experimentation and innovation, evaluated a number of options — from evolving their existing CMS platform, to other page-building solutions. He needed something that could easily plug into Intuit's existing tech stack, while enabling non-engineers users to create rich visual content quickly.

1001129800.text: With Plasmic, Intuit found a solution that helps with:

1001129913.text: Allow many teams to build experiments in parallel without conflicting with each other, scaling with business needs.

1001130070.text: "Plasmic has provided a huge boost for us. Developers can focus on code rather than content, while design teams can build components and content that seamlessly integrates into our existing stack. By enabling these teams to craft their own experiments, Plasmic lets us ship over twice as fast and expedite our learnings."

1384027524.text: Internal tools are software applications used by an organization's team members to carry out their tasks more effectively. These may include project management tools, data analysis tools, communication platforms, and more.

1384027526.text: What types of internal tools can I build with Plasmic?

1384027528.text: With Plasmic, you can build a wide range of internal tools, including project management tools, data analysis tools, dashboards, CRMs, and more. The platform's flexibility means it can be adapted to suit a vast array of use cases.

1384027530.text: How can I improve the user experience for my internal team members?

1384027532.text: With Plasmic, you can leverage a set of building blocks that look and function great right out of the box. If you want to create a fully customized and unique user experience, Plasmic also allows you to tailor every element, from layout to functionality.

1384027534.text: Can non-technical team members use the internal tools built with Plasmic?

1384027536.text: Yes, Plasmic's internal tools are designed to be user-friendly. The tools you build can be made intuitive and straightforward, suitable for users with varying levels of technical expertise. Plus, with Plasmic's content creator mode, non-developers can safely make edits focusing just on content.

1384027538.text: How fast can I build an internal tool with Plasmic?

1384027540.text: Building internal tools with Plasmic can be much faster than traditional coding, thanks to its visual builder and pre-built components. The exact timeframe will depend on the complexity of the tool you're building, but the platform is designed to significantly speed up the development process.

1384027542.text: Can I integrate other software with the internal tools built on Plasmic?

1384027544.text: Yes, Plasmic allows for integrations with various other software. This means you can pull in data from or push data to other platforms your team is already using, which can greatly enhance the effectiveness of your internal tools.

1384027546.text: Is it possible to scale internal tools as my business grows?

1384027548.text: Absolutely. With Plasmic, scalability is built in. The platform is designed to grow with your business, allowing you to add more data sources, custom components, and integrations as needed. Furthermore, deploying your tools as a React application or integrating with your existing infrastructure ensures that you maintain full control over the tool's environment, facilitating easy scaling as your team expands.

2901735832.text: A workspace is an organizational unit within an organization. Organizations can contain multiple workspaces, and each workspace can house numerous Plasmic projects. Organization members can be added to workspaces or individual projects. For example, you could have an organization for your agency with separate workspaces for each client, or an organization for your company with workspaces for each department.

2901735851.text: What's the difference between private and public users?

2901735852.text: Public users can sign in to any project that allows public sign-in, while private users need special permission to access certain projects. If your project has sensitive info, you'll want to use private sign-in to keep things secure.

2901735857.text: We keep track of users by their unique email addresses, and it doesn't matter how many devices they use to log into your Plasmic project. Also, we only count active users—potential users in your Users table won't affect your total.

2901735861.text: Collaborators can build and edit Plasmic applications in your workspace. There are two types: workspace collaborators, who can access all applications in the workspace, and guest collaborators, who can only access specific applications they've been invited to.

2901735866.text: We use built-in analytics to count the number of unique views across any page of your website featuring a Plasmic design. This only applies to content delivered via the Headless API, not codegen.

2901735936.text: How much does an Enterprise plan cost?

2901735941.text: Each Enterprise plan is tailored to your needs, so the pricing varies. To find out more, fill out this [child] and get in touch with us.

2901735951.text: A Plasmic badge appears on any published application or website you build with the free plan. If you want to remove the badge, simply upgrade to a paid tier.

2901735953.text: Is Plasmic secure? How can I be sure my data is safe?

2901735963.text: We take security seriously. Our cloud infrastructure is hosted in US data centers that are SOC 1, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 certified. Our data centers have round-the-clock security, fully redundant power systems, two-factor authentication, and physical audit logs. Check out our [child] for more info.
